scope: existing exported excursion labels only; no raw-price execution, no P&L, no blind holdout, no gates cleared
question: Incremental descriptive value of fast exit within wide prior-range context, versus range-only and speed-only
weights: Reuse prior within-block weights; aggregate buckets by their weight mass, never average bucket rates unweighted. Equal mean of three block rates.
independent_check: Recompute every policy rate directly from exact pinned raw exports, independent Counter weights and math.fsum; use published training-only edges unchanged
limitations: History already exposed; source/geometry as-of uncertified; excursion is bounded from exited edge, not entry returns. Fast exit timing is anchor-to-exit, not distance-per-bar or pullback speed.
